name: Groupize
description_en:
Groupize currently presents itself as an AI-based platform for corporate meetings, events and group travel, with aime agents described as supporting sourcing, approvals, registration, logistics and reconciliation. The former groupize.com entry redirects to groupize.ai, so the current identity is broader than a simple attendee-registration tool.

The official service terms describe hosted, fee-based access under agreed Work Orders. They can limit users and service volume and define additional work separately. Marketing statements about autonomous work, savings or complete compliance are not independently tested results and should not replace a review of the actual operating permissions and agreement.
description_zh:
Groupize 目前以企业会议、活动及团体旅行的 AI 平台呈现，aime Agent 被描述为支持寻源、审批、报名、物流和对账。原 groupize.com 跳转至 groupize.ai，因此现行身份比简单报名工具更广。

官方条款描述按约定 Work Order 提供付费托管访问，可限制用户和服务量，额外工作另行定义。自动执行、节省或全面合规等营销说法不是独立测试，不能代替实际权限与协议核查。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate sourcing, approvals, registration, logistics and budget reconciliation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 协调寻源、审批、报名、物流及预算对账。

core_features.name_zh: 按工作单定义 SaaS 范围
core_features.explanation_en: Hosted subscription access and additional services are defined in signed Work Orders.
core_features.explanation_zh: 托管订阅和额外服务由签订的工作单定义。

en: Coordinate a corporate meeting’s venue requests, approvals and registration with explicit spending authority.
zh: 在明确支出权限下协调企业会议寻源、审批及报名。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Map the workflow and approval rights, review the Work Order and AI data terms, then demo an exception with disposable data.
steps.zh: 映射流程及审批权限，核对工作单和 AI 数据条款，再用可丢弃数据演示异常。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Work Order-defined hosted subscription, user/volume scope and services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Fee-based hosted subscription and services scoped in a Work Order; user and volume limits may apply, with term no longer than thirty-six months per order. No standard public amount or numerical billing unit verified. Additional services require agreed scope changes.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按工作单定义付费托管订阅及服务，可有用户和量上限，每份期限最长 36 个月。未核实标准公开金额或数值计量单位，额外服务需约定范围变更。

sources.title: Groupize AI
sources.research_notes_en: Current official groupize.com redirect to groupize.ai presents aime agent-based corporate meetings, sourcing, approvals, registration and travel. Vendor savings/compliance percentages not adopted.

sources.title: Terms of Service – Groupize AI
sources.research_notes_en: Terms of Service dated December 15 2025 define fee-based hosted subscription under Work Orders, user/volume limits, rights over AI inputs/outputs and no accuracy warranty.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.
Official legacy groupize.com homepage redirected to groupize.ai during this read; current identity updated from that observed redirect, not from a directory label.

sections.title_en: Define which actions the team may delegate
sections.title_zh: 明确团队可以委派哪些动作
sections.en: The current site describes venue search, RFP comparison, budget optimization, approval enforcement and registration/logistics. For an illustrative internal meeting, first specify approved venue requirements, spending authority and who must confirm a booking. Ask a demo to show one exception and its audit record. Described agent capabilities do not prove that an AI can spend, negotiate or approve correctly without configured boundaries. No agent action was executed here.
sections.zh: 现行网站介绍场地搜索、RFP 比较、预算优化、审批执行和报名/物流。例如内部会议，应先明确场地要求、支出权限及谁确认预订。演示应展示异常及审计记录，Agent 描述不能证明 AI 在没有配置边界时仍能正确支出、谈判或批准。本文未执行任何 Agent 动作。

sections.title_en: Read the subscription scope in the Work Order
sections.title_zh: 在工作单中核对订阅范围
sections.en: The terms grant fee-based, non-transferable hosted access for the term and functionality in the Work Order; an individual Work Order may not exceed thirty-six months. User and service-volume limits can be specified. Additional services require an agreed amendment or new order. No standard public amount, free production tier or fixed billing unit was established. The demo-request page is a sales route, not a numerical price source.
sections.zh: 条款按工作单中的期限和功能授予付费、不可转让的托管访问，单个工作单不得超过 36 个月，可指定用户及服务量上限。额外服务需双方同意新单或修订。本次未确定标准金额、免费生产层级或固定计量单位。演示申请只是销售入口，不是数值价格来源。

sections.title_en: Review AI input rights before supplying confidential data
sections.title_zh: 提供机密数据前核对 AI 输入权利
sections.en: Section 1.6 describes use of company prompts and outputs in AI operations and grants broad rights over AI inputs and resulting outputs. The same terms disclaim accuracy and suitability of AI-derived outputs. These clauses need agreement-specific review before uploading confidential attendee, supplier or regulated information; the homepage’s ring-fenced-data statement is not enough to infer a no-training guarantee. This is a description of the read terms, not a legal conclusion about a negotiated contract.
sections.zh: 第 1.6 节介绍公司提示与输出的 AI 使用，并授予 AI 输入和结果较广权利；同一条款不保证 AI 输出准确或适用。上传机密参与者、供应商或受监管信息前，需结合协议核对，不能仅由首页数据隔离说明推导出“不训练”保证。这是已读条款描述，不是对协商合同的法律结论。

sections.title_en: Match enterprise operations to the actual service agreement
sections.title_zh: 让企业运营与真实服务协议匹配
sections.en: Groupize merits investigation when corporate sourcing, travel and policy workflows need to connect. A small social event may not need this operating model. Terms describe internet/browser access to a provider-hosted production service and reserve source rights; no self-hosted distribution or open-source license was established. Pilot approvals, downstream records and recovery with representative data, and review the applicable export, retention and support commitments. Savings and compliance percentages were not measured.
sections.zh: 企业寻源、旅行和政策流程需要连接时可研究 Groupize，小型社交活动未必需要这种模式。条款描述通过网络/浏览器访问供应商托管生产服务，并保留源码权利；未确认自托管发行版或开源许可。应使用代表性数据核对审批、下游记录和恢复，以及适用导出、保留和支持。本文未测量节省及合规比例。

research_gaps: No aime agent, venue bid, booking, approval, registration, integration or recovery was tested.
Actual quote/billing unit, AI data carve-outs, negotiated agreement, export/retention/residency, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
